scope: ADS8866 selected 3-wire CS mode digital timing contract only

official_sources.review_method: pypdf layout and pdfplumber text; page 8 table and Figure 44 visually checked

mode.name: 3wire_CS_DIN_high
mode.DIN: tied to DVDD; high at every CONVST rising edge
mode.CNV_alias: CONVST pin 6, functioning as CS; not a separate CNV pin
mode.SCLK: idle low, host samples rising edges; bits advance falling edges
excluded: optional early CS pulse for other devices

conversion_interval.note: 10000 wraps as 1000 plus 0 in original PDF; visually checked

CONVST_high.note: selected implementation holds high until tCONV-max, stronger than pulse minimum

conditions.electrical_table: min/max at AVDD=3V, DVDD=3V, VREF=5V, 100kSPS over free-air range unless otherwise noted; typical at 25C
conditions.digital_output_test: 500uA source/sink, CLOAD=20pF, page7; no board parasitic guarantee
conditions.host_setup_hold: no real host supplied; trace instantaneous sample only. Board/host timing budget blocked

semantics.conversion: internal clock; disconnected sampling inputs; no current-result read during conversion
semantics.acquisition: starts when conversion completes; datasheet permits reading during acquisition
semantics.serial_frontend: additional conservative system rule: frontend only released after DOUT Z, then 1200ns acquisition eligibility; does not disable physical ADC acquisition
semantics.output: 16-bit straight binary, D15 first, D0 last; ideal tagged words, not an analog voltage converter
semantics.DOUT_trace: chosen boundary envelope: current valid through min hold; X until max next-data delay; Z at max disable delay. Not silicon waveform or typical delay
semantics.startup: t=0 externally asserted supplies/reference/frontend ready, then >=1200ns initial acquisition. No guaranteed power-up delay specified here
semantics.source_differences: Only one current official source used. p6 and p8 agree tCONV 500 min/8800 max and tACQ 1200 min; no typical tCONV. p1 full-scale settling headline does not guarantee arbitrary driver/RC. p2 states Rev C changed SCLK throughput text; earlier PDF not obtained or relied on.

blocked_external_evidence: AVDD monotonic ramp and brownout recovery <=0.7V, DVDD/REF readiness and validated first-sample delay
Actual source/mux/driver, RC tolerances, step amplitude, stability, kickback, acquisition residual and cross-point memory
Reference driver and capacitor load stability, dynamic droop, noise, drift, INL/offset/gain error over real conditions
Host input setup/hold, IO levels, pin loading, PCB delay/skew/jitter and real logic-analyzer waveforms
RTL/firmware CDC, reset, timeout, fault safety and 8-point hardware trace
Training sensitivity and actual ADC precision budget; no system +/-1% acceptance
